notes.title: Klobgniak 0.3.3.3 (Halloween Update)
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

The first update for "[b]Klobgniak[/b]" has arrived!
These are the following changes:

[list]
[*][b]HUD[/b] now shows that you have picked up the "[b]hammer[/b]" or "[b]scissors[/b]".
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added icon "[b]?[/b]" as one of the hints next to the items that the player should pay attention to.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added option for mouse sensitivity in "Pause Menu".
[/list]

[list]
[*] "[b]Collect[/b]" and "[b]Interact[/b]" function is now on the same key ([b]E key[/b]).
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Mr. Resident[/b] is slowed by [b]15%[/b].
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added small details in "[b]Klobgniak's Home[/b]".
[/list]

[b]AND[/b]

[list]
[*] Pumpkin.
[/list]

That's all in this update. Interact with this post and leave your feedback! Also, what do you think about the current state of this game? Your information would help me a lot. 

Thanks in advance!


[b]Cheers![/b]
